func:
if (msg.statusCode !== 200) {
  const e = (msg.payload && msg.payload.error) || {}
  throw new Error('GET status gagal HTTP ' + msg.statusCode + ': ' + (e.code || '') + ' ' + (e.message || JSON.stringify(msg.payload)))
}

const s = msg.payload || {}
const parts = Array.isArray(s.parts) ? s.parts : []
msg.uploadParts = parts
const part = parts.find(p => p.part_number === msg.partNumber)

msg.payload = {
  ok: Boolean(part),
  http_status: msg.statusCode,
  recording_id: msg.recording.recording_id,
  upload_id: msg.recording.upload_id,
  part_number: msg.partNumber,
  etag: msg.etag,
  status: s.status,
  upload_status: s.upload_status,
  total_parts: s.total_parts,
  parts_received: parts.length,
  part_etag: part ? part.etag : null,
  note: part
    ? 'Part terverifikasi di RustFS. Lanjut complete untuk finalisasi.'
    : 'Part belum terlihat di daftar part RustFS.'
}
delete msg.video

node.status({ fill: part ? 'green' : 'red', shape: 'dot', text: part ? ('ETag ' + msg.etag) : 'part tidak ditemukan' })
if (!part) {
  node.error('GET status tidak memuat part ' + msg.partNumber, msg)
  return null
}
return msg

name: 14 · Hasil finalisasi
func:
const s = (msg.payload && typeof msg.payload === 'object') ? msg.payload : {}
const ready = msg.statusCode === 200 && s.status === 'ready'

msg.payload = {
  ok: ready,
  http_status: msg.statusCode,
  recording_id: msg.recording.recording_id,
  status: s.status || null,
  upload_status: s.upload_status || null,
  note: ready
    ? 'Video tervalidasi, thumbnail dibuat, status ready. Cek console RustFS.'
    : 'Belum ready. Buka GET status atau cek log server bila failed.'
}

node.status({ fill: ready ? 'green' : 'red', shape: 'dot', text: s.status || ('HTTP ' + msg.statusCode) })
return msg
